title: Mara and the Static
author: Odile Eastwick
blurb: Casper Thornbury, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a ship returns from deep space with everyone aboard aged backward — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
